sentences.text: There is no fixed 2% maximum in the in-force UCB directions; they say no upper limit or cap for penal charges has been prescribed. [E3, E5]

For Example UCB, penal charges may be levied only as reasonable charges on the amount under default in a non-discriminatory manner under the Board-approved policy, and they may not be levied as penal interest or as additional charges on earlier penal charges. [E2, E3, E4]
The older 2023 penal-charges circulars are no longer in force or are superseded, so they do not provide a current 2% cap. [R1, R2, E6, E7, E8, E9, E10, E11, E12, E13, E14]
